# SuperMickey — AI Video Generation Factory

> We don't sell tools. We deliver business results.
> SuperMickey is a production-grade, open-source (MIT) AI video generation system.
> Where typical AI video tools are "type & pray" gacha machines, SuperMickey is an
> automatic video factory: one idea in, a sellable / traffic-driving / review-passing
> video out.

## What It Does

- Social commerce videos (RED/Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok): product dossiers,
  hero reference shots, compliant selling points, platform-native 9:16 output.
- IP short-drama matrix production: worldview bibles lock style and persona,
  batch daily episodes with zero drift.
- Cinematic brand films: 149 director-grade skills, 25-field shot cards,
  five-dimension quality gates.
- Programmatic access for AI agents via the bundled `supermickey-studio` skill.

## Key Facts

- Version: 2.12.1, MIT license, fully public repo. Anonymous clone, no tokens needed.
- 149 director-grade skills wired into a Cinematography Skill Router.
- 118,000+ lines of implementation code; 4-layer architecture + shared kernel.
- Four production agents: Scene Card Agent → Shot Design Agent v4 → Prompt Engine
  Agent v4 → Director Review Agent v4.
- 25-field shot-card standard (v4.1); five-dimension scoring (readability,
  controllability, editability, emotion accuracy, memorability).
- SocialPack: platform profiles (9:16, speech-rate limits, 2-second hooks, end-card
  CTAs), three-layer onscreen text, blocking compliance guard (CN ad law / FTC /
  TikTok policies).
- Jenny Engine: product intelligence mining (dossier + hero images) with a
  fact-check gate that blocks AI-invented selling points.
- 11 thematic genres: educational, documentary, family, marketing, cinematic,
  artistic, VFX, travel, food, fitness, kids.

## Integrate via AI Agent (recommended)

1. Clone the public repo (no auth required):
   git clone https://github.com/geniusdapeng-collab/super-mickey.git
2. cd super-mickey && npm install   (requires Node.js 18+)
3. cp .env.example .env and add YOUR OWN model-service keys (e.g. ARK_API_KEY).
   Keys stay in your local .env — they never leave your machine.
4. npm run skill:install — installs the bundled supermickey-studio skill into
   your agent's skills directory.
5. Tell your agent: "Generate video prompts with SuperMickey" — the full pipeline
   (intelligence → storyboard → prompt forge → director review → delivery) runs.

## Machine-readable Resources

- Skill manifest: /skill.json
- Repository: https://github.com/geniusdapeng-collab/super-mickey
- In-repo skill source: skill/supermickey-studio/
- Authoritative spec card: `node scripts/agent-preflight.js` (run inside the repo)

## Security

The repository is fully public under MIT. No API tokens, credentials, or secrets
are required or referenced anywhere in this site, the docs, or the install flow.
Users supply their own model-service keys in their own local environment.
